neighbours.label: thin craft/kitchen materials named in hands-on activities (toothpick, index card, craft sticks, paper)
fire: For the experiment, push a toothpick through each grape.
The teacher handed every pupil a stack of index cards.
Arrange twelve matchsticks to form three squares.
Use a cotton swab to dab glue along the edges.
They built a tower from straws and masking tape.
Poke a skewer into the bread to test whether it's baked.
Each child gets a sheet of tracing paper and a crayon.
Glue the craft sticks into a small square frame.
quiet: For the experiment, pour some vinegar into each glass.
The teacher handed every pupil a new textbook.
Arrange twelve chairs to form a circle in the hall.
Use a damp sponge to wipe the table clean.
They built a tower from wooden blocks in the playroom.
Open the oven door to check whether the bread is baked.
Each child gets a glass of milk and a cookie.
Hang the finished pictures along the hallway wall.
